name: Koi no Curry Sawagi
source:
You go to school and help out at the curry shop where your parents work.
Because you work at the shop all the time, you have no time to go out with your friends and meet new people.
Then one day, you see a couple at the shop next to yours eating curry together, and you say to yourself “ I want a boyfriend.”
Suddenly, you see a bright light from the curry that you have been stirring. When you open your eyes, you see 4 attractive guys.
They are from the curry kingdom who are looking for a wife in the human world. They were the curry fairies. They all want you to be their girlfriend, which one will you fall in love with?

translation:
你去学校并在父母工作的咖喱店帮忙。
因为你一直在店里工作，你没有时间和朋友出去认识新朋友。
然后有一天，你看到一对夫妇在你旁边的商店一起吃咖喱，你对自己说“我想要一个男朋友。”
突然，你看到正在搅拌的咖喱发出明亮的光芒。当你睁开眼睛时，你看到4个帅气的男人。
他们来自咖喱王国，正在人间寻找妻子。他们是咖喱仙子。他们都想让你做他们的女朋友，你会爱上哪一个呢？
